overview_description.description:
Humaans is a provider of HRIS employee management software for remote and distributed teams. Instead of a one-size-fits-all software platform, the company's employee management platform enables organizations to maintain a central hub of employee data while building a customizable people operations stack. The stack assists businesses in managing employee data, documents, reporting, and the people processes that drive the entire structure. It allows organizations to create a customizable HR stack that manages employee documents, data, payroll, contracts, and other "people ops" components

Their goal is to automate the entire employment lifecycle and simplify complex manual processes like onboarding, offboarding, promotions, compensation management, and more.

about_short_description.short_description: Humaans provides an HRIS platform that helps businesses manage employee data, onboarding, workflows, and the complete employee lifecycle.

product.name: Humaans HRIS Platform
product.description: A cloud-based HRIS software that centralizes and automates employee lifecycle management for remote and distributed teams.

product.name: Humaans AI Companion
product.description: An AI-powered assistant that provides instant answers to HR-related queries and automates document creation and workforce insights.

product.name: Process Automation
product.description: Automation of HR workflows including onboarding, offboarding, compensation reviews, and performance management.

product.name: Insights & Reporting
product.description: Provides real-time analytics on turnover, headcount, salary spend, absence, tenure, and other workforce metrics.

product.name: Workflows and Requests & Approvals
product.description: A workflow engine that automates HR processes with triggers, approvals, and email automation to enhance operational efficiency.

product.name: Headcount Planning and Compensation Management
product.description: Tools for real-time workforce planning and compensation management to align HR and finance strategies.
